correctness.rationale: For every integer m>=1 on labelled book graph K2 joined to m independent leaves, under simultaneous loopless chip firing all vertices share the same number k of firings per period (connected Laplacian). For q=3, single firing per vertex requires distinct hub phases; predecessor-phase neighbor multiplicities and binomial sum yield 6*m*2^(m-1) states, doubled by complement involution and divided by 3 => N3=m*2^(m+1). For q=4, one-fire hub phases antipodal, multiplicity m(m-1)2^(m-2) per one of four rotations; complement doubles k=1 and k=3 classes. Source's complete six-word analysis forbids primitive k=2 four-cycles; alternating hubs yield only period two. Thus N4=m(m-1)2^(m-1) with crossing m=5. Independently enumerated all confined labelled states for m=1..4 by literal updates and confirmed (N3,N4)=(4,0),(16,4),(48,24),(128,96). Analytic all-m phase argument, not finite test, proves theorem; source verifier inspected.
